8.name: Pyre Vows
8.desc: +10% ability damage. Your blows smolder long after they land.
8.hint: A straightforward vow of fire — burn brighter, burn longer.

8.name: Crown of Cinders
8.desc: +5% ability damage, and your wounds heal 10% faster from hearts.
8.hint: The crown weighs little and answers quickly.

5.name: Lantern of the Sun
5.hint: Carry a bigger lantern into the deeper dark.

5.name: War March
5.desc: +10% cast speed — the procession does not wait.
5.hint: More casts, more often, all descent long.

2.name: Final Verdict
2.desc: +10% ability damage, and the sigils strike wider.
2.hint: The verdict is read once; it covers everyone.

2.name: The Unconquered Sun
2.desc: +10% ability damage while the sun still stands with you.
2.hint: Stand unbroken and the light answers.

8.name: Glyph Memory
8.desc: +5% cast speed — the glyphs write themselves faster now.
8.hint: A well-read scholar is a fast scholar.

8.name: Thrice-Veiled
8.desc: Tome Shield holds one extra ward, granted now.
8.hint: A scholar never travels with one page of defence.

5.name: Star Map Spread
5.desc: +25% pickup reach — the map shows what glitters.
5.hint: Fragments, coins and reagents drift toward you from farther.

5.name: Quill of Foretelling
5.hint: Write and rewrite — until the book is full.

2.name: The Hidden World
2.hint: Step out of the world more often.

2.name: The Allsage
2.desc: +8% cast speed — the forbidden name comes easier.
2.hint: The rhythm of the 4th-cast surge carries you.

8.name: Lullaby Depth
8.desc: +5% cast speed — the song reaches further each verse.
8.hint: Open with sleep; the crowd conducts itself.

8.name: Mirror Nerve
8.hint: Agony is ammunition — take hits early, spend them late.

5.name: Siren Chorus
5.desc: +8% ability damage while the choir sings.
5.hint: Conduct the field — every sleeping ear is yours.

5.name: Agony Bond
5.desc: +5% cast speed — the bond tightens between victims.
5.hint: Pain that moves is pain that multiplies.

2.name: World as Mirror
2.desc: +10% ability damage inside the reflected world.
2.hint: Your signature becomes the answer to everything you endured.

2.name: Apocalypse Whisper
2.desc: +8% ability damage while the last verse approaches.
2.hint: End the song only when everything is sleeping.

dawnbringer.name: Sun Ascension
dawnbringer.desc: Master the Red Priest by burning legions at dawn.

tiers.boon: Elites take +10% more damage from you
Gate bosses take +15% more damage from you

wanderer.name: Ink Ascension
wanderer.desc: Master the Hermit by writing your fate in the margins.

hollow_seer.name: Mirror Ascension
hollow_seer.desc: Master the Demoness by ending what sleeps.

ascension.desc: An Ascended descent re-fights the endgame at rising difficulty for richer rewards. Each tier steps the pressure up; the Study shows your deepest tier.
